notes.title: New Breach content now live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27581024/c922beeefe212cec932ac576825c473c6a297289.png[/img]

Hi everyone! We've updated Breach today with a slew of all-new content, as well various adjustments and bug fixes.
[list]
[*][b]New PICUS Servers:[/b] Scattered throughout the Palisade Networks are 11 all-new Picus Corporation server maps for you to master.
[*][b]PICUS Darknet File:[/b] SLEIGHT OF HAND
[*][b]New Feature - Ghost Networks:[/b] Randomly generated server networks are made available each day. Players can complete them for extra rewards.
[*]New Booster Packs added to Breach Shop
[*]New Premium Weapons added to Breach Shop, including Exclusive Premium Weapon – HyperION
[*]New Breach Achievements
[*]Color themes for Default Skin can now be changed
[*]Special Ammo can now be purchased using Weapon Parts
[*]Firewall Keys can now be purchased using Praxis
[*]Various improvements and bug fixes have also been made
[/list]
